# http_signatures v0.1.3 - Table of Contents

> Library for manipulating and validating HTTP signatures

## Modules

- [HTTPSignatures](https://http-signatures.hexdocs.pm/HTTPSignatures.md): HTTP Signatures library.

- [HTTPSignatures.Adapter](https://http-signatures.hexdocs.pm/HTTPSignatures.Adapter.md): Contract for HTTPSignatures adapters.
